entries.title: Joel 3:1
segments: For, behold, in those days and in that time, [when] I will bring again the exiles of Judah and Jerusalem,

entries.title: Joel 3:2
segments: I will also gather all nations and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat. And I will fight with them there for My people and for My inheritance Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and divided My land.

entries.title: Joel 3:3
segments: And they have cast lots for My people, and have given a boy for a prostitute, and sold a girl for wine, so that they might drink.

entries.title: Joel 3:4
segments: Yea, and what [have] you to do with Me, O Tyre and Sidon, and all the borders of Philistia? [Will you] give Me a reward? And if you reward Me, swiftly and speedily I will turn your reward on your own head,

entries.title: Joel 3:5
segments: because you have taken My silver and My gold, and have carried My good treasures into your temples.

entries.title: Joel 3:6
segments: You have also sold the sons of Judah and the sons of Jerusalem to the sons of the Greeks, that you might remove them far from their border.

entries.title: Joel 3:7
segments: Behold, I [am] rising them out of the place where you have sold them, and will turn your reward on your own head.

entries.title: Joel 3:8
segments: And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the sons of Judah, and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off; for the LORD has spoken it.

entries.title: Joel 3:9
segments: Proclaim this among the nations: Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up.

entries.title: Joel 3:10
segments: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruning hooks into spears. Let the weak say, I [am] strong.

entries.title: Joel 3:11
segments: Gather yourselves and come, all you nations, and gather yourselves together all around; cause Your mighty ones to come down there, O LORD.

entries.title: Joel 3:12
segments: Let the nations be awakened and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat; for there I will sit to judge all the nations all around.

entries.title: Joel 3:13
segments: Put in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Come, come down; for the press is full; the vats overflow, for their wickedness is great.

entries.title: Joel 3:14
segments: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision; for the day of the LORD [is] near in the valley of decision!

entries.title: Joel 3:15
segments: The sun and the moon shall be darkened, and the stars shall gather in their light.

entries.title: Joel 3:16
segments: The LORD shall also roar out of Zion and utter His voice from Jerusalem. And the heavens and the earth shall shake. But the LORD [will be] the hope of His people and the strength of the sons of Israel.

entries.title: Joel 3:17
segments: So you shall know that I [am] the LORD your God dwelling in Zion, My holy mountain. And Jerusalem shall be a holy thing, and no aliens shall pass through her any more.

entries.title: Joel 3:18
segments: And it shall be, in that day the mountains shall drop down new wine, and the hills shall flow [with] milk, and all the rivers of Judah shall flow [with] waters; and a fountain shall come forth from the house of the LORD, and shall water the valley of Shittim.

entries.title: Joel 3:19
segments: Egypt shall be a ruin, and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, from violence [done] to the sons of Judah, whose innocent blood they poured out in their land.

entries.title: Joel 3:20
segments: But Judah will dwell forever, and Jerusalem to generation and generation.

entries.title: Joel 3:21
segments: And I will cleanse their blood [which] I did not cleanse; and the LORD is dwelling in Zion.
